fields.summary: Aircraft list — search and filter capabilities
fields.description:
As a dispatcher I want to view the aircraft list so that I can see all registered aircraft.
As a dispatcher I want to search by tail number so that I can find a specific aircraft.
As a dispatcher I want to filter by operational status so that I see only active aircraft.
As a dispatcher I want to sort by base location so that I can group aircraft by region.
As a dispatcher I want to export the filtered list so that I can share it with my team.
